skill.description: Delegate bounded coding tasks to Claude Code CLI with explicit scope and review gates.

memory.responsibility: Retain bounded coding request plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform repository instructions into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through claude code session while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only repository, runtime, and verification capabilities required by the bounded engineering task.

stages: Define files behavior and stop conditions

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
